name: Dragon Ascent
description: You soar upward and come crashing down towards a creature in range at tremendous speed. Make a melee attack roll, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Any creature within 10 feet of the target must make a {save} and take the same amount of damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. After activating this move, any attack roll that targets you until the beginning of your next turn is rolled with advantage.
